description: This file defines the 'Logging' annotation used for controlling logging behavior in the OpenMRS API, including options to ignore logging, suppress argument values, and specify argument indexes to ignore.

classes.name: Logging
classes.description: Annotation used to provide additional options for API logging, such as ignoring arguments or suppressing logs for specific methods.

methods.name: ignore
methods.description: Indicates whether to suppress automatic logging of the annotated method.

methods.name: ignoreAllArgumentValues
methods.description: Indicates whether to suppress printing the argument values when the method is logged.

methods.name: ignoredArgumentIndexes
methods.description: Specifies specific argument indexes that should not be logged, useful for sensitive data.
